note: Manual tags per model, in the five fields of the style guide. type is material (what it is made of, closed, 36, parented — a model carries the subtype it is, never the parent on top), kind (what it is — the tree in lint/kinds.json, exactly one per model; the id is the path, so the parent is the id minus its last segment), use (what it is for, zero or more, stored and never implied by kind), theme (a theme set a model belongs to), attribute (a property read off the model in steps, such as storeys), or tag (anything else worth finding, such as flags). size is measured at build and never listed here. Descriptions state the membership rule, not the members: the models list is the membership. Set with catalog/swipe.html or the model panel in index.html; build-catalog.mjs attaches them to catalog.json. po: true marks a tag only the PO assigns.

tags.name: Metal
tags.description: Metal with no subtype named: use it only where the reading is metal but neither iron, gold, silver nor copper fits.

tags.name: Iron
tags.description: Iron of any kind, as the parent of steel, wrought and cast. A model carries the subtype it is, never this on top.

tags.name: Steel
tags.description: Steel: the worked, edge-holding iron of melee weapons, equipment, tableware and tools. Takes light grey 15,3.

tags.name: Wrought iron
tags.description: Wrought iron: forge work — hoops, straps, fittings, chain, nails, lantern frames. Takes dark grey 13,3.

tags.name: Cast iron
tags.description: Cast iron: poured, heavy and brittle — cannon and shot, gratings, gates, fences, cooking pots. Takes blue-grey 6,1.

tags.name: Gold
tags.description: Gold: bars, nuggets, coins, rings, gold keys and trim. Takes gold 6,0.

tags.name: Copper
tags.description: Copper: bars, nuggets and their stacks. Takes terracotta 5,0 and never shares a model with another metal subtype.

tags.name: Wood
tags.description: Worked wood with no band named: use it only where none of planks, worked, beam, log or bark fits.

tags.name: Planks
tags.description: The surface reads as planks, cut square: signs, staves, boards, plank floors, plank furniture, scaffolding. Takes light brown 0,0.

tags.name: Worked
tags.description: Planks shaped into a thing rather than lying as stock: barrels, kegs, buckets, crates, chests, trunks, plank furniture. Takes mid brown 1,0.

tags.name: Beam

tags.name: Log

tags.name: Bark
